mechanism_families: Representation and Parameter Analysis / Steering Vectors (M3b)

findings.description: M3a uses Probing / Residual Stream States correctly: block-wise s capture, chain-level split, balanced multinomial LogReg, permutation null
M3a claims decodability only, not causal sufficiency — appropriate scope for linear probe
v_charge = L2_normalize(w_pos - w_neg): standard signed direction extraction from linear probe weights; L2 norm after normalize = 1.0 confirmed
M3b uses Steering Vectors (additive CAA-style) correctly: s += β·σ_proj·v_charge at block-input pre-hook
β=+3σ → ~64.7 residual-stream units perturbation; random control also shows hairpin_rate=100% confirming hairpin is robust to any direction at this strength

M3b null is scientifically valid: pLDDT change <0.003 at β=+3σ rules out structural collapse; 175/179 chains hairpin=1 across entire β sweep. Consistent with probe-positive/steering-negative literature (Belrose 2023, Marks&Tegmark 2023).
M3a test set = 4 chains (~736 residues). Under-scale vs planned 250 chains. Mitigated by perfect bacc=1.0 with perm p<0.001 across all 4 blocks — charge is trivially decodable.
